question.problem: Let $b$ be directly proportional to $g.$ Given that $b=98$ when $g=-7$, find the value of $b$ when $g=\frac{31}{7}.$
question.worked_solution:
Since $b$ varies directly with $g,$ we use the equation

$$
b=kg.
$$

We are told that $b=98$ when $g=-7.$ We substitute this data into the equation to find $k:$

$$
\begin{aligned}98 & =k\cdot (-7) \\ \frac{98}{(-7)} & =k \\ -14 & =k\end{aligned}
$$

So, the direct variation equation is given by

$$
b=-14g.
$$

Finally, substituting the value of $g=\frac{31}{7}$ into this equation gives

$$
\begin{aligned}b & =-14\cdot \frac{31}{7} \\  & =-2\cdot 31 \\  & =-62.\end{aligned}
$$
